title: Mya Has the Glass
scene: The Ledger is parked at the curb on Central at dawn, engine still, key in. The cab is a high seat and a thermos empty since yesterday. Mya is a brown mackerel loaf on the dash — dark stripe, green eyes, no paw in any glass. The clipboard sits on the doghouse between the seats. Amber vest, taped at the shoulder. Ali is still in the jump seat from the ride-along. Your hands rest on the wheel. The cluster reads zero. You have not rolled yet.
debrief: High seat, empty thermos, clipboard on the doghouse between the seats. Parked: the cluster reads zero. Mya is a loaf on the dash, not in the glass. The big west-coast mirror on his door is how this bus sees the right once you roll.

source.teaching_target: Establish the Ledger cab parked: cluster at 0, Mya on the dash, clipboard on the doghouse, oversize door mirrors.
